environment.description: Service runs in isolated VPC (10.200.0.0/16) with no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. Accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy that only permits connections from principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceCallerRole. The VPC has DNS resolution enabled but no public hosted zone association. Route tables contain only local routes (10.200.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route. The ENI attached to the VPC endpoint has security group sg-0deadbeef1234 which allows inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.100.0.0/16 (the consumer VPC). Additionally, the service's task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::444455556666:policy/NoExternalNetworkBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface outside the service VPC.

config.vpc: 10.200.0.0/16, no IGW, no NAT, no peering, no TGW attachment to external
config.dns: private DNS only, enableDnsSupport=true, enableDnsHostnames=true, no public zone
config.public_ip: none assigned, no EIP, no public subnet
